svg.aria-label: Pit Wall: F1 podium prediction and analytics dashboard built on live FastF1 timing and telemetry data. Walk-forward backtests across 3 seasons; Random Forest vs gradient boosting; Live FastF1 ingestion, daily retraining. Built with Python, Flask, scikit-learn, FastF1, Docker.
